crossRefs.note: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.
My soul is also in great anguish. But you, Yahweh—how long?
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…

translations.web: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?
translations.bsb: Will You never look away from me, or leave me alone to swallow my spittle?
translations.kjv: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
translations.asv: How long wilt thou not look away from me, Nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
